So the register value is corrupted by extraction artifacts, while the document value "Nanjing Ningyuan Intelligent Instrument Co., Ltd." is clean and clearly refers to the same company.

Alternatively, verdict "same-entity" since it's clearly the same company (spelling/OCR drift), and best_value = document's value because it's the clean reading and the certificate is the legal instrument.
